item.title: MARVEL MAXIMUM COLLECTION Packs 13 Retro Marvel Game Versions Into One Massive Release
item.description: MARVEL MaXimum Collection brings six retro Marvel classics and 13 total arcade and console versions to modern platforms, complete with online play, bonus content, and quality of life upgrades.

item.title: LEGO BATMAN: LEGACY OF THE DARK KNIGHT Cinematic Recreates Iconic Museum Scene From 1989 BATMAN Movie
item.description: Warner Bros. Games has released a LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight cinematic, recreating the 1989 museum scene from DC's Batman movie in playful brick-built form.

item.title: HE-MAN AND THE MASTERS OF THE UNIVERSE: DRAGON PEARL OF DESTRUCTION Retro Brawler Release Date Announced
item.description: Limited Run Games has announced that He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction, a retro-inspired 2D brawler, will launch for consoles and PC in April.

item.title: New PS5 Games: Here's What's Releasing For PLAYSTATION 5 In March 2026
item.description: March heats up for PS5 with major releases like Marathon, Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection, MLB The Show 26, and Crimson Desert, plus dozens more launching throughout the month.

item.title: New NINTENDO SWITCH 2 Games Releasing In March 2026
item.description: March 2026 brings a huge lineup of new and remastered games to Nintendo Switch 2, from Pokémon Pokopia and Monster Hunter Stories 3 to Super Mario Bros. Wonder and Legacy of Kain.

item.title: MARVEL RIVALS Unveils 2026 Roadmap Building Toward AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY
item.description: Throughout 2026, Marvel Rivals will be hosting new games and events inspired by the Marvel Cinematic Universe all the way up to the upcoming release of Marvel Studios' Avengers: Doomsday.

item.title: Meet Your Max and Chloe: Prime Video Reveals Leads For LIFE IS STRANGE TV Series
item.description: Prime Video has cast Tatum Grace Hopkins and Maisy Stella as Max and Chloe in its live-action Life Is Strange series, offering fans a first look at the iconic characters brought to life.

item.title: MARATHON Launch Times Announced, Here Is When You Can Hop In
item.description: Bungie's Marathon arrives tomorrow globally on PS5, PC, Xbox. The Server Slam rewards will carry over, new Thief Runner Shell debuts, and Deluxe bonuses will be available as well.
